changelog:
Initial release — search TikTok Shop products by keyword and region.

- Extracts comprehensive TikTok Shop product data from public search pages using keyword and country code.
- Returns product details including id, title, price, currency, seller info, shop, rating, reviews, sold count, images, SKU variants, brand, and product URL.
- Supports pagination and multi-region searches for competitor analysis and market research.
- Requires only the search page to be open in a browser; no login or special access needed.
- Includes error handling for missing results, captchas, and region restrictions.
summary: Extract product search results from TikTok Shop by keyword and country region — returns product id, title, price, currency, seller, shop, rating, review count, sold count, images, SKU variants, brand, and product URL. Use when user mentions TikTok Shop, tiktok shop scraper, tiktok shop search, tikto
